source_policy: Maintained source only. Exact inverse restores pre-adaptation source identity for verification; never generate selected production RTL.
completion: Only original SPI session spidone after complete payload, CRC and CS-high release; bad or missing CRC becomes sticky read_error code 3, never done
streaming_prefix_limitation: Payload remains streamed before CRC verdict. A failed sector invalidates its session; this does not prove no bad byte was already consumed or sector atomic publication.
